stem: \[2(x - y) = 3y + 1\] \[x + y = 11\] If \((x, y)\) is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of \(y\)?
solution: From the second equation, \(x = 11 - y\). Substitute: \(22 - 2y - 5y = 1\), so \(7y = 21\) and \(y = 3\).
verify:
x, y = symbols('x y')
sol = solve([2*(x - y) - (3*y + 1), x + y - 11], [x, y])
assert sol == {x: 8, y: 3}
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [sol[y]]
